headline: Iran Proposes Seven-Day Ceasefire Plan as IDF Drone Accident Kills Two Soldiers
subheadline: Iran offers $12 billion asset release and Hormuz reopening on day six while Gaza drone crash halts all IDF armed flights.
lede: Iran has proposed a seven-day plan to Washington demanding a halt to all fighting, release of at least $12 billion in frozen assets, and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz on day six. Two IDF reserve soldiers were killed in a drone accident inside Gaza, prompting a complete halt of all armed drone flights across IDF units. Gulf states remain divided, with Saudi Arabia and UAE pressing for continued economic pressure while Oman and Qatar advocate de-escalation.

sections.title: Russian Air Defenses Down 55 Drones
sections.body: Russian air defenses shot down 55 Ukrainian drones overnight over Russian regions and the Black Sea. Ukrainian drone and missile strikes were reported across Kyiv and Zhytomyr. DeepStateUA reported Russian forces occupied Novooleksandrivka and advanced near Yurkevka and Vasylivka. Trump urged Zelenskyy to visit Moscow for negotiations, but Zelenskyy declined.

sections.title: Iran Seven-Day Plan Meets Gulf Division
sections.body: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi proposed a seven-day plan to Washington including ceasefire, $12 billion asset release, and Strait of Hormuz reopening on day six. Two IDF soldiers were killed when an FPV 'Atalef' drone crashed into their base in Gaza, killing Nadav Kali and Ofek Moalem. The IDF ordered a complete halt of all armed drone flights pending investigation while Saudi Arabia's Grand Mufti called for military readiness against Houthis.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's phased proposal represents the most significant diplomatic development but faces skepticism from Gulf states and internal denial. The IDF drone accident marks a significant operational setback for Israel's drone-dependent warfare doctrine. Continued strikes in Lebanon and interceptor launches indicate the northern front remains active despite diplomatic overtures.
